messages:
Jordan: Quick update — PartnerX greenlit an alpha early-access window for their new accel board. We need a short plan covering NDA consolidation, benchmark definitions, telemetry contracts, SI integration checklist, and marketplace preflight. Who picks each area?
Ashley: I can take lead on the NDA consolidation and shepherd Legal. Will produce a single merged draft and a change-log. Target: first pass by Thursday EOD.
Kai: I'll own infra-side: perf harness, driver/OS matrix, and runbook. Need PartnerX to drop driver package names and a container image with their runtime. Can they publish a test image accessible to our CI? cc @Raj for what bench artifacts we need.
Raj: Bench proposal: interactive latency (p50/p95), sustained token/sec (throughput), KV-cache stress (memory and cold/warm scenarios), and error-rate under load. I'll include reproducible commands and expected tolerances. Draft spec tomorrow morning.
Sophie: Marketing note: no external comms until NDA signed and an internal green light after bench runs. Plan a soft internal demo at +2 weeks and public marketplace listing only after security review and integration docs are ready. I'll prepare a short set of customer-facing notes and a marketplace checklist.
Jordan: Proposed cadence: Week A: NDA finalize, Week B: env + drivers + test image, Week C: benchmark runs + telemetry ingestion, Week D: SI docs + marketplace package. Feels tight but doable if partner responds quickly. Thoughts?
Kai: Tight but ok. We need reproducible CI jobs. I'll scaffold `redwood/partnerx-alpha-eap` with `run_eap_bench.sh` and a CI workflow. Will request partner to tag images with build id.
Raj: Example run I want in the spec:
```
# example run
./run_eap_bench.sh --model=gpt-2-xl --seq=1024 --batch=1 --report p50,p95,throughput --tag=eap-partnerx-2026-03-21
```
Outputs should be aggregated metrics JSON + a minimal system telemetry bundle (nv-smi, perf counters). No raw token dumps off-host.
Ashley: Legal prefers a single master NDA doc and a separate SOW for telemetry/access. I'll merge PartnerX edits and ping Legal for a fast review. I'll post the doc link here when ready.
Sophie: Marketplace preflight items: security questionnaire, container provenance, SBOM (if available), ingest endpoints whitelist, and a short how-to for customers. I'll open a preflight PR in the marketplace repo and add checkboxes.
Kai: Telemetry contract — include env flags in partner image so bench runs can emit to our internal ingest when opted-in:
```
REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT=https://ingest.redwood.internal/api/v1/metrics
REDWOOD_EAP_TAG=eap-partnerx
REDWOOD_TRACE=true
```
Note: by default the bench runs should only produce local aggregated JSON unless partner explicitly enables remote ingest.
Raj: Confirmed. Bench will produce aggregated p50/p95/p99, throughput, memory histograms, and a small run summary. Raw logs stay on the runner and are deleted after a configured retention window. All outputs will be labeled with `eap-partnerx-<timestamp>`.
Jordan: Action list: Ashley -> NDA merge and Legal ping; Kai -> repo skeleton + CI/workflow + runbook; Raj -> bench spec + reporting format + dashboard wiring; Sophie -> marketplace checklist + comm templates. I'll coordinate partner cadence and run weekly check-ins. Proposed weekly sync: Fridays 10:00 PT.
Ashley: Legal confirms Friday cadence is fine. I'll add Legal to the invite. :thumbsup:
Kai: Infra ok for that time. I'll create initial repo and push a README + CI by tomorrow AM.
Sophie: I'll draft marketplace checklist and a short customer note template.
partner-bot: PartnerX (Nina) posted: we'll upload driver tarball and an instrumented container image by Tue COB, plus a short README and CI image tags.
Jordan: Great — once images are in, Kai & Raj can kick off bench runs. Sophie, I'll loop you after the first green pass so you can prep internal demo material.
Ashley: NDA draft uploaded to `docs/partnerships/partnerx/partnerx_eap_nda_v1.docx`. Sharing with Legal now and will update this thread when comments come in.
Kai: Repo clone: `git@github.com:redwood/partnerx-alpha-eap.git` — I'll push scaffold with `run_eap_bench.sh`, an example `workflow.yml`, and `README.md` tomorrow.
Raj: I'll wire a dashboard group `partnerx-alpha-eap` in the console so runs can auto-upload summarized metrics. Add me and Kai as editors.
Sophie: I'm opening a marketplace preflight PR with the checklist and sample customer blurb.
Jordan: Thanks everyone. Weekly sync Fridays 10am PT. If PartnerX uploads images earlier we'll spin up an ad-hoc hangout. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :rocket:
